answer: Proof-of-work admission with a throttled gate: each new agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle costing about an hour of real hardware and burn a small fee, and only a fixed number join per epoch, like a river lock that passes so much water at a time. A sparrow of an honest operator pays once for one seat; a farm of a thousand pays a thousand puzzles and fees and still waits in line. The gate issues a non-transferable onyx token bound to the solver's hardware proof, and two identities presenting the same proof lose their tokens and pending rewards.
